# mcp.vin — Free VIN Decoder & MCP Server
> Full docs: https://mcp.vin/llms-full.txt

## About
mcp.vin combines free public vehicle data from NHTSA, EPA and manufacturer sources, with representative stock photos. Public lookups require no API key. The unified workspace and MCP server use the same source adapters.

## Features
- VIN validation and decode (NHTSA)
- Safety ratings (NHTSA 5-star)
- Recall notices
- Consumer complaints
- EPA fuel economy data
- Vehicle photos
- VIN-specific manufacturer recall status where verified; unknown repair history remains unknown
- Vehicle configuration research, comparison, safety records and ownership calculations
- Saved vehicles and preferences with a website account

## API
- GET https://mcp.vin/api/vin/:vin — Decode a single VIN
- GET https://mcp.vin/api/vin/:vin/validate — Quick validation
- GET https://mcp.vin/api/vin/:vin/recalls — Recalls only
- GET https://mcp.vin/api/vin/:vin/complaints — Complaints only
- GET https://mcp.vin/api/vin/:vin/safety — Safety ratings
- GET https://mcp.vin/api/vin/:vin/fuel — Fuel economy
- GET https://mcp.vin/api/vin/:vin/photo — Vehicle photo
- POST https://mcp.vin/api/batch — Decode multiple VINs ({"vins":[...]}, up to 50)
- GET https://mcp.vin/api/tools — Authoritative directory of all 22 MCP tools, grouped by task
- GET https://mcp.vin/api/research/capabilities — Supported features and explicit gaps
- https://mcp.vin/research/api.json — Research endpoint guide

## MCP Server
- Stdio: npx -y vin-mcp (or node server.mjs)
- HTTP: POST https://mcp.vin/mcp (Streamable HTTP transport)
- Vehicle reports: decode_vin, validate_vin, lookup_recalls, batch_decode
- Research: explore_capabilities, vin_recall_status, vehicle_catalog, epa_vehicle, vehicle_emissions, fuel_price_assumptions, owner_reported_mpg, defect_investigations, auto_loan_benchmarks, vehicle_dimensions, manufacturer_communications, compare_vehicles, ownership_scenario
- Account: list_saved_vins, save_vin, remove_saved_vin, get_output_preferences, update_output_preferences (require a website login token)
- Hosted and GitHub source versions may be newer than the npm package; use HTTP or current source for the full tool set.
- Model-year recall campaigns and complaints do not establish VIN repair status or individual safety rankings. Missing data is not zero.
